column1: # What each of the 108 Lingua languages (kernel/src/lingua/catalogue.tsv) is
# best at, and which kinds of app feature it owns. One language per line,
# language: exactly as the catalogue names it.
# runtime:  the zxapp language a manifest names ("logic <runtime> ..."), or
#           "-" while there is no front-end. A language with "-" owns its
#           features on paper only: no manifest may claim it until its
# owns:     comma-separated feature kinds (see the "kinds" list in
#           tools/apps/lang_coverage.py). Two languages may own the same kind;
#           that is how a critical answer gets its second witness.
